hook: Cyber Towers–HITEX stretch shut *9 am to noon* today
hook_b: Cyber Towers–HITEX stretch shut *9 am to noon* today
tldr: Cyberabad Traffic Police have restricted traffic in Madhapur on November 14 for a gig workers' bike rally with Rahul Gandhi from Shilpakala Vedika to Jayabheri Grounds.

beats.what: Vehicles are restricted from Cyber Towers to HITEX Kaman (Metal Charminar) and up to HICC/Novotel from 9 am to 12 noon; heavy vehicles are barred on these routes.
beats.why: The rally comes as Rahul Gandhi is set to launch the Telangana Platform-Based Gig Workers law at the Bharat Summit at HITEX.
beats.care: Cyber Towers to Kondapur traffic goes via Yashoda-Vasantha City Road, Novotel and RTA Junction; Kothaguda to Cyber Towers goes via Radisson, AIG and IKEA Rotary.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Drones, paragliders and micro-light aircraft are banned in Madhapur from 7 pm Nov 13 to 6 pm Nov 15; Rajnath Singh visits the summit on Nov 15.

cards.q: How are you getting around Madhapur this morning?

qs: What does the new gig workers' law require from delivery and ride apps?
How many gig workers ride in Hyderabad daily?

facts.t: The Gig Workers Bill was introduced in the Assembly on *March 29, 2026*.

viz.verdict: Morning traffic curbs, drone ban through Sunday evening

watch: Restrictions end at noon; the drone ban stays until 6 pm on November 15.
